meta.prompt: Show my grocery order as an inline card before you place it, with the number of items at the top. Five lines, each with a picture placeholder, its price and a quantity I can raise or lower (removing the line at zero): Bananas 1 kg $2.50 x1, Whole milk 2 L $3.20 x2, Sourdough loaf $4.50 x1, Free-range eggs $5.00 x1, Cheddar $7.00 x1. A promo code field where SAVE10 takes 10% off the subtotal, delivery of $4.99, and the subtotal, promo and total kept up to date as I change things. Confirm and cancel buttons that tell you what I decided.
meta.text:
ChatCard "Your grocery order" "Review before placing" icon:"shopping_basket" status:"{length(cart)} items"
  state cart=[{"id":1,"name":"Bananas","detail":"1 kg","price":2.5,"qty":1},{"id":2,"name":"Whole milk","detail":"2 L","price":3.2,"qty":2},{"id":3,"name":"Sourdough loaf","detail":"1 loaf","price":4.5,"qty":1},{"id":4,"name":"Free-range eggs","detail":"12 pack","price":5.0,"qty":1},{"id":5,"name":"Cheddar","detail":"400 g","price":7.0,"qty":1}]
  state promo=""
  state decided=""
  state sub=sum(cart,x=>x.price*x.qty)
  state discount=promo=="SAVE10"?sub*0.1:0
  state total=sub-discount+4.99
  each x in cart
    CartLine title:=x.name detail:=x.detail price:=x.price*x.qty kind:"box" qty:=x.qty -> cart=removeWhere(updateWhere(cart,c=>c.id==x.id,c=>with(c,"qty",result)),c=>c.qty==0)
  Input "Promo code" "Enter code" =promo
  Details rows:=[["Subtotal",money(sub,"$",2)],["Promo SAVE10",money(-discount,"$",2)],["Delivery","$4.99"]]
  TotalBar "Total" "Delivery included" amount:=money(total,"$",2) cta:"Confirm" -> decided="confirmed"
  Row gap:10
    ActionButton "Cancel" quiet -> decided="cancelled"
    ActionButton "Confirm order" primary -> decided="confirmed"
  if decided=="confirmed"
    Receipt "Order placed" "Your groceries are on the way." code:"ORDER-1042" tone:good icon:"check"
  if decided=="cancelled"
    Receipt "Order cancelled" "Nothing was charged." tone:neutral icon:"close"
